caseNameFull: Reno, Attorney General v. Kim Ho Ma

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. Motion of Washington Legal Foundation et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of respondent for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Certiorari granted, case consolidated with No. 99-7791, Zadvydas v. Davis et al., immediately supra, and a total of one hour allotted for oral argument.
